title: amphirhapis peduncularis

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is used to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Amphirhapis peduncularis include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include annonaceous acetogenins, which have been shown to exhibit potent cytotoxic and antitumor activities.
